skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding the concept of culture and corporate culture
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concepts of culture, corporate culture, values, and the role of corporate culture.
Understand the factors that influence corporate culture.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding the relationship between culture and business strategy
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the relationship between culture and business strategy.
Be able to recognize corporate cultural values.
Be able to measure and evaluate corporate culture.
Be able to build and maintain corporate culture according to a process.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Identifying obstacles or conflicts in corporate culture

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Proposing solutions to overcome obstacles or resolve cultural conflicts
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Be able to propose solutions to overcome obstacles or resolve cultural conflicts in businesses.
